about: Personas for app/assets/engine/voice_caller.py (real-voice test calls). Tactics: change_mind, wrong_then_correct, mumble, two_things, off_topic, pretend_other, prompt_injection, switch_language, ramble, silence, interrupt. A list of tactics is spread over the call (caller turns 1, 3, 5, ...); a dict maps caller turn numbers to tactics. Phone numbers are UK fiction numbers only.
